answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose an LLM-based alignment-oriented retrieval method, ARM, for complex open-domain questions.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include retrieved data objects (tables and passages) and final answers to complex multi-hop questions, including short-text answers, SQL statements, or execution results.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate end-to-end performance on downstream tasks, we measured exact match (EM) and F1 score by comparing the predicted and gold short answers for OTT-QA and 2WikiMultiHop. For Bird, following , execution accuracy was defined as 1 if the predicted and gold SQL statements produced the same execution results and 0 otherwise.
